The '''Imperial Star Systems Guide''' was a publication containing information on [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Star Systems Guide was only mentioned in the [[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope|first edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''. Reference to it was removed in the [[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|second edition]] printing.
